sound.label: Sound
sound.description: A drum for every hit the act plays, a click for the count, a ding when it is your turn, a ping for your own hits.

judge.label: Timing
judge.description: Relaxed: a hit counts within about a tenth of a second of its beat. Strict: half of that.

reset.label: Start over
reset.description: Flip this switch to clear everything this app has kept and see the guide again. Each flip starts over once. Cannot be undone.
